Ten comments

Heaton Chapel

I transcribed this tune from the Lunasa CD Otherworld.It was composed by Kevin Crawford.The tune Autumn child preceeds it -and
I`ll be posting that in shortly.
Apparently I`ve just found out from their Website that a book containing all the tune from the first 3 Albums is due out in the Autum. So pending that ( more accurate version?) heres mine.
Chris

↳ Posted by Christopher Reynolds on March 1st, 2002.
